fields.name: WorkspaceId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Workspace.

fields.name: ReaderIds
fields.description: Server-stamped ACL: IAM user ids that may read the row.

fields.name: CreatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the creating actor, set by the function.

fields.name: UpdatedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the last writer.

fields.name: ProjectId
fields.description: ItemId of the owning Project.

fields.name: Kind
fields.description: Job kind. One of: requirements.draft|sanitization.assist|design.generate|scope.grill|milestones.suggest|board.plan|build.run|change.build|change.analyse|fix.analyse|preview.deploy|wiki.generate|chat.reply|engine.skills-sync.

fields.name: Status
fields.description: Job status. One of: queued|claimed|running|succeeded|failed|cancelled.

fields.name: ActiveKey
fields.description: <Kind>:<TargetId or project> while queued, claimed or running; the job's own ItemId once finished; the unique (ProjectId, ActiveKey) index allows one active job per kind and target, which replaces the design's Run schema.

fields.name: TargetType
fields.description: Kind of row the job targets.

fields.name: TargetId
fields.description: ItemId of the row the job targets.

fields.name: InputJson
fields.description: Job input as a JSON string.

fields.name: OutputRefs
fields.description: ItemIds of the rows the job produced.

fields.name: Progress
fields.description: Progress percentage, 0 to 100.

fields.name: Message
fields.description: Latest progress or status message.

fields.name: Attempts
fields.description: Number of claim attempts.

fields.name: ClaimedBy
fields.description: Engine identity that claimed the job.

fields.name: ClaimedAt
fields.description: When the job was claimed.

fields.name: StartedAt
fields.description: When the job started running.

fields.name: FinishedAt
fields.description: When the job finished.

fields.name: ErrorCode
fields.description: Error code when the job failed.

fields.name: RequestedByUserId
fields.description: IAM user id of the requester.

fields.name: RequestKey
fields.description: Idempotency key <op>:<requestId>[:<n>], set by the server; unique index.

fields.name: UsageJson
fields.description: What the job's lanes measured, JSON {v:1, tokens:{in,out,cacheRead,cacheWrite,total}, costUsd, models:[...], agents, lanes} (src/domain/billing.ts parseJobUsage); written by the engine worker as each lane finishes.
